name: apiary-deck-grow-wild-v1
description: ⭐⭐ DEAN'S APIARY RETEXT, RULED IN 14/09/2026, AND SINCE THEN THE SHIPPED DEFAULT: under reference-v18 this overlay changes nothing. The Apiary Notice Board reads "Grow a building using the top card of any deck", and the deck card pays ANY activation cost (Dean: "it's a way of bypassing the suit requirements"). Measured as an arm on reference-v17 seeds before the ruling, it moved Dairy's win rate from 36.6% to 50.4% and Apiary's from 40.2% to 25.9%. The game it replaced is overlays/notice-board-apiary-sow-v1.overlay.json; the rejected literal reading is apiary-deck-grow-v1.
